join_strategy: ibge_municipio when available; fallback to UF + normalized municipality name

coverage_interpretation.cobertura_aps_pct: Nominal potential coverage from the source file. Values above 100% are kept as capacity signals.
coverage_interpretation.cobertura_aps_capped_pct: Coverage capped at 100% for population coverage interpretation.
coverage_interpretation.coverage_gap_pct: Positive gap below 100%; values above 100% do not create a negative gap.
coverage_interpretation.nominal_capacity_excess_pct: Nominal excess above 100%, useful as a capacity-over-population signal.
